title: SparsePixels: Efficient Convolution for Sparse Data on FPGAs
abstract: arXiv:2512.06208v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Inference of standard convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on FPGAs often incurs high latency and a long initiation interval due to the deep nested loops required to densely convolve every input pixel regardless of its feature value. However, input features can be spatially sparse in some image data, where semantic information may occupy only a small fraction of the pixels and most computation would be wasted on empty regions. In this work, we introduce SparsePixels, a framework that implements sparse convolution on FPGAs by selectively retaining and computing on a small subset of active input pixels while ignoring the rest, reducing the per-layer compute from $O(HWK^2C_{\text{in}}C_{\text{out}})$ to $O(n^2C_{\text{in}}C_{\text{out}})$ and the storage from $O(HWC)$ to $O(nC)$ when $n^2\ll HW$. translated_title: SparsePixels：FPGA上稀疏数据的高效卷积
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.06208v4 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：在FPGA上对标准卷积神经网络（CNN）进行推理，往往因需要深度嵌套循环来密集卷积每个输入像素（无论其特征值如何）而导致高延迟和长启动间隔。然而，在某些图像数据中，输入特征可能具有空间稀疏性，其中语义信息可能仅占据像素的一小部分，大部分计算会浪费在空白区域上。在这项工作中，我们介绍了SparsePixels，这是一个在FPGA上实现稀疏卷积的框架，通过选择性保留并仅计算一小部分活跃输入像素，而忽略其余部分，将每层计算量从$O(HWK^2C_{\text{in}}C_{\text{out}})$降低到$O(n^2C_{\text{in}}C_{\text{out}})$，存储量从$O(HWC)$降低到$O(nC)$，当$n^2\ll HW$时。由于计算始终在合成时冻结的单一预指定像素预算上运行，推理延迟与数据无关。
tldr: SparsePixels提出了一种在FPGA上高效处理稀疏卷积的框架，通过仅计算活跃像素，大幅降低计算和存储开销，并确保推理延迟与数据无关。
en_tdlr: SparsePixels introduces a framework for efficient sparse convolution on FPGAs by computing only active pixels, significantly reducing compute and storage costs while ensuring data-independent inference latency.
